submitted.rationale: Of the three measurements spread across the composition line, index 14 (Sb 0.236) had the highest EQE at 2.7e-4 %. That is about twice index 28 (Sb-rich end) and about 1.5 times index 7 (Y-rich end). This suggests a maximum in the middle of the line, near Y3SbO7 (Sb 0.25). All EQE values are very low, as expected for these wide-gap oxides under 2.7 eV light.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 1.35e-4 %, half that of index 14
